ratings.reason: Staged entry and finite location encounters produce a clearer sequence and quieter start. The broad gold warden has a long readable charge and an actual temporary armor opening after a phase break; precise optic fire and ordinary fire remain viable. Distinct triage, repair and relay props add contextual identity. The spaces remain one shared courtyard with related drone enemies, limited systemic encounter variation, simple art and no human enjoyment/listening evidence. This supports a modest prototype gameplay improvement, not perfection or AAA readiness.
